incidents.title: Karmelo Anthony Trial — Day 2, Emotional Testimony Phase
incidents.location: Collin County Courthouse, McKinney TX (~200 mi NE)
incidents.detail: Day 2 of the Karmelo Anthony murder trial. Prosecution showed jury Anthony's bloody jacket from the stabbing. Austin Metcalf's last words disclosed in court — highly emotional testimony ongoing. Coach Vincent Hooper testified Anthony appeared genuinely distressed and cried at scene. Hundreds lined up daily for limited courthouse seats; demonstrators outside clashing — heated exchanges between supporter factions reported Thursday. Trial expected through end of next week. Verdict-reactive protest watch for Austin remains active — monitor Capitol/Congress Ave corridor.
incidents.source: FOX 4 / NBC News / YouTube LiveNOW, June 5, 2026
